The property

The Residence

Carlton Ridge pairs the easy rhythm of island living with the space to spread out across six thousand square feet, arranged across the main house and separate, private garden residence.

At a glance

6 bedrooms · 12 guests · 4-bedroom main house · 2-bedroom garden residence

Living spaces

Living spaces built around light and breeze

The main house holds four en-suite bedrooms around a central living and dining space that opens fully to the garden. Nothing here is closed off — the kitchen sees the dining table, the living room sees the terrace, the terrace sees the pool.

Kitchen

A double oven and a run of counter space built for real cooking, opening directly onto the covered dining patio so nothing gets cold, or lonely, on the way to the table.

Living Room

High ceilings and cross-breezes from ceiling fans throughout, with the living area folding out onto a covered terrace for indoor-outdoor evenings.

Games Room

A games room just off the terrace, with a full-size pool table and board games for slower evenings.

The bedrooms

Four bedrooms, each built for rest

Four en-suite bedrooms spread across the main house, each with its own character and views over the gardens or pool.

Master Suite

Wake to garden and pool views in the main master suite, which opens directly onto a covered veranda. It has its own TV and seating area and a walk-in dressing room with make-up table, making this the villa’s most private and spacious bedroom.

Master Bathroom

A generous en-suite designed for unwinding, featuring his-and-hers vanities, a deep bath and an enclosed steam shower. After a day by the pool or exploring the island, it’s a lovely place to slow down and recharge with robes and slippers, local toiletries from St Lucy Botanists included.

Poolside Guest Suite

A guest bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, fitted wardrobes and double doors opening onto a private patio, overlooking the pool and gardens.

Garden Guest Suite

A guest bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, walk-in wardrobe and double doors opening onto a private patio, tucked among the villa’s tropical gardens.

Garden Guest Suite

A guest bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, walk-in wardrobe and double doors opening onto a private patio, tucked among the villa’s tropical gardens.

Also on the estate

The Garden Residence

A private, self-contained two-bedroom retreat with its own entrance and parking — ideal for family or guests who want a little more independence.

Living Room

Self-contained living space with its own full kitchen.

Patio

A patio with a path through the gardens to the pool.

Garden Residence Suite One

An air-conditioned en-suite bedroom with a full-size bed (UK king-equivalent) and walk-in wardrobe.

Garden Residence Suite Two

A second en-suite bedroom, with the same independent comfort and garden setting.

Explore the Garden Residence

The grounds

Gardens, pool & a wet bar built for long afternoons

The outdoor deck and pool sit within manicured gardens dense with flowering trees, framed by a gazebo and wet bar built for entertaining.

  • Private heptagonal pool with sun deck
  • Gazebo & outdoor wet bar
  • Covered dining patio
  • Games room with pool table
  • Whole-property backup generator
  • Two 1,000-gallon water tanks & softener
  • Full irrigation system
  • Electronic gates & alarm system
